verdict.rationale: The evidence shows `.parallel()` for running distinct workflow steps at the same time, and a code mode for multi-tool computations. Neither is a documented capability for applying one operation across many items in bulk, such as batch or foreach-over-collection processing. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the bulk-operations capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
